KEY RULE, as ruled: where the NULL dereference is not in the function the upstream fix edits, the row is keyed at the dereference itself when it is inside the corpus, consistent with aurora_lint 1418's violation-site rule. src/utils/wpabuf.h:60 is the dereference inside the wpabuf_len() inline reached from src/eap_server/eap_server_peap.c (upstream 0da59aadc). wpa_supplicant/events.c:2165 is the first member dereference of 'selected' in wpa_supplicant_need_to_roam_within_ess(), reached from wpa_supplicant/wnm_sta.c (upstream e341c11d9); the wpa_bss_ie_ptr() call on the line above computes an address and is not taken as the dereference.

NOT KEYED, as ruled: wpa_supplicant/ctrl_iface.c (upstream f3b1fc3b9). Its dereference is inside a libc string function, outside the corpus, so there is no in-corpus line to key.

VERIFIED FOR BOTH ROWS: no existing row at the same (file, line, rule) on main at submission, and aurora-lint at aurora_lint_sha does not report EXP34-C at that line over the pinned hostap commit (full-checkout scan, same invocation as the real-world runner; src/utils/wpabuf.h is inside the scan).

A key inside a shared inline (wpabuf.h:60) stands for every call that reaches it. This row is placed for the one path above and says nothing about other callers.
